notes.title: Never Grave: The Witch and The Curse official release (v1.0) has been decided!
notes.content:
[h3][b]･Official release version (v1.0) of Never Grave: The Witch and The Curse has been announced![/b][/h3][p]It has been decided that Never Grave, originally planned as an early access title, will instead launch directly as the official v1.0 release![/p][p][/p][p]Due to the valuable feedback from many players during the demo period, we have decided to deliver the game in its complete form, rather than in staged Early Access. The development team is currently making final adjustments to ensure that you receive the best gaming experience from day one. Stay tuned![/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]･Multi-platform release and crossplay![/b][/h3][p]In addition to the Steam version, we have decided to release the game for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation®4, PlayStation®5, Xbox Series X|S, and Microsoft Store. In addition, it will support crossplay between all platforms, allowing multiplayer across all devices.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]・Please note, we will be closing the Steam demo soon.[/b][/h3][p]Thank you so much for playing the demo and sending in so much feedback and suggestions.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Version v0.1b.1416 Update
notes.content:
Dear Players,
Thank you for playing the Never Grave demo.
We're pleased to announce some updates that have been made.

v0.1b.1416
- Tweaked the controller stick input dead zone for UI interactions.
- Improved the underwater audio effects by reducing the excessive emphasis on low-frequency sounds.
- Fixed a bug in the Demise Shop where a grimoire named "LocNoData" would appear.
- Slightly sped up the action of throwing tools.
- Addressed various minor bugs.

We hope you continue to enjoy playing the Never Grave demo. Thanks for your support.

notes.title: Demo Version v0.1b.0910 Update
notes.content:
Dear Players,
Thank you for playing the Never Grave demo.
We're pleased to announce some updates that have been made.

v0.1b.0910
- Now you can customize key bindings for the mouse.
- Adjusted the status screen to allow swapping between Magic A and Magic B.
- Fixed a bug where all tool attacks were treated as backstabs.
- Corrected an issue where the effect of "Black Grimoire: Inflicts X poison on enemies that have 50% HP or less" wasn't working properly.
- Increased the time needed for tomatoes to grow from 7 seconds to 30 seconds.
- Addressed various minor issues.

We hope you continue to enjoy playing the Never Grave demo. Thanks for your support.

notes.title: Demo Version v0.1b.0718 Update
notes.content:
Dear Players,
Thank you for playing the Never Grave demo.
We're pleased to announce some updates that have been made.

v0.1b.0718
- Slightly widened the dead zone for joystick input.
- Allowed tool attack cancelling with regular attacks.
- Allowed canceling from magic attacks into various actions.
- Increased the maximum usage count for tools.
- Decreased the attack power of tools.
- Allowed tools to pierce pots.
- Allowed oil jars to pierce enemies.
- Fixed a bug where a boss could move off-screen.

We hope you continue to enjoy playing the Never Grave demo. Thanks for your support.

notes.title: Demo Version v0.1b.0714 Update
notes.content:
Dear Players,
Thank you for playing the Never Grave demo.
We're pleased to announce some updates that have been made.

v0.1b.0714

- Allowed magic cancelling with regular attacks.

notes.title: Demo Version v0.1b.0619 Update
notes.content:
Dear Players,
Thank you for playing the Never Grave demo.
We're pleased to announce some updates that have been made.

[u][b]An issue was found that caused the difficulty level to change unintentionally. We've fixed it, so please take a moment to check your difficulty settings.[/b][/u]

v0.1b.0619
- Resolved a bug in the settings menu where selecting an unrelated option resulted in unintentional changes to the difficulty setting.
- Corrected a bug that caused the character to crouch in mid-air after performing an aerial attack.
- Adjusted the color of the water to improve the visibility of underwater enemies.
- Made it so sound plays in underwater mode when the player's head is inside the water.

We hope you continue to enjoy playing the Never Grave demo. Thanks for your support.

notes.title: Demo Version v0.1b.0519 Update
notes.content:
Dear Players,
Thank you for playing the Never Grave demo.
We're pleased to announce some updates that have been made.


v0.1b.0519
- Significantly improved rendering performance. As a side effect, audio distortion issues should also see improvement.
- Adjusted the player's and possessed dog's moving attacks to prevent them from passing through enemies, reducing the chance of receiving undue contact damage.
- Allowed the possessed dog to pass through one-block passages.
- Fixed a bug where the button input icons were not displayed correctly when the language setting was set to "English."
- Adjusted the players's normal combo attack so that damage increases with each strike. Specifically, decreased the attack power of the first strike, increased the power of the second strike, and significantly increased the power of the third strike.
- Fixed an issue with the axe monster's attack detection and super armor detection having too long durations.
- Addressed several minor bugs.
- Made some minor balance adjustments.

We hope you continue to enjoy playing the Never Grave demo. Thanks for your support.

notes.title: Demo Version v0.1b.0119 Update
notes.content:
Dear Players,
Thank you for playing the Never Grave demo.
We're pleased to announce some updates that have been made.

v0.1b.0119
- Added potion-replenishing facilities at the terminus of the 1st & 2nd layers.
- Significantly improved rendering performance.
- Enhanced the settings menu to support mouse usage.
- Fixed a bug where, after switching applications using the keyboard and returning to the game, 
  the controller icons remained in keyboard mode even when using a gamepad.
- Fine-tuned several aspects related to the player character's movement.
- Made the transition from evasive action to running more smooth.
- Added a tutorial about underwater jumping.
- Fixed a bug where the boss's slamming attack would not track the player character when on the outer side.
- Made significant adjustments to ensure that boss battles conclude in a shorter time.

We hope you continue to enjoy playing the Never Grave demo. Thanks for your support.

notes.title: Demo Version v0.1.3020 Update
notes.content:
Dear Players,
Thank you for playing the Never Grave demo.
We're pleased to announce some updates that have been made.

v0.1.3020
- Mitigated the BGM audio distortion issues.
- Slightly extended the collision range for regular combo attacks.
- Fixed a bug where the player couldn't use the blue portal next to the boss door.
- Fixed a bug where the player character would flip when falling or jumping after hanging from a cliff.

We hope you continue to enjoy playing the Never Grave demo. Thanks for your support.

notes.title: Demo Version v0.1.2920 Update
notes.content:
Dear Players,
Thank you for playing the Never Grave demo.
We're pleased to announce some updates that have been made.

v0.1.2920
- Set the movement distance of the Neutral combo regular attack to 0.
- Made the hitstop for regular attacks more lenient.
- The hitstop during regular attacks now also affects other enemy characters, not just the player.
- Corrected an issue where Ice Circle wouldn't disappear when hitting objects like pots.
- Fixed a bug where breaking walls in a room with a second layer of water would still show the wall graphics.
- Fixed a bug where you could drop the witch's body in the witch's cauldron.
- Even if the witch's body is not present, made it so that summoning it from hat form is possible. 
(We expect this will allow to summon the witch even when loading from data which was saved in hat form.)

We hope you continue to enjoy playing the Never Grave demo. Thanks for your support.

notes.title: Demo Version v0.1.2703 Update
notes.content:
Dear Players,
Thank you for playing the Never Grave demo.
We're pleased to announce some updates that have been made.

v0.1.2703
